description: The project will have up to 147 wind turbine generators
context_quote: The Project would have a capacity of up to 2,400 MW and would consist of up to 147 WTGs in the Lease Area

description: The project will have up to 5 offshore substation platforms
context_quote: The Project would have a capacity of up to 2,400 MW and would consist of up to 5 OSPs and associated export cables.

description: The project will have up to 6 offshore export cables within a single export cable corridor
context_quote: From one (1) or more (no more than five (5)) OSPs within the lease area, up to six (6) offshore export cables (up to four (4) power cables and up to two (2) communications cables) within a single, 1,640 – 2,300-foot wide, offshore export cable corridor (OECC) will travel a total of 124 miles

description: The offshore export cables will travel a total distance of 124 miles
context_quote: From one (1) or more (no more than five (5)) OSPs within the lease area, up to six (6) offshore export cables (up to four (4) power cables and up to two (2) communications cables) within a single, 1,640 – 2,300-foot wide, offshore export cable corridor (OECC) will travel a total of 124 miles

description: The offshore export cable corridor will be 1,640 to 2,300 feet wide
context_quote: From one (1) or more (no more than five (5)) OSPs within the lease area, up to six (6) offshore export cables (up to four (4) power cables and up to two (2) communications cables) within a single, 1,640 – 2,300-foot wide, offshore export cable corridor (OECC) will travel a total of 124 miles

description: The project will have 250 miles of inter-array cables
context_quote: Project 1 will develop the northeastern portion of the lease area and will include up to 85 WTGs connected by 250 miles of IACs to one (1) OSP, and up to three (3) export cables (two (2) power cables and one (1) communications cable) within the OECC to Brayton Point.

description: The wind turbine generators will be arranged in a 1-by-1-nautical mile offset grid pattern
context_quote: SouthCoast Wind would space WTGs in a 1-by-1-nmi offset grid pattern (east–west-by-north–south- gridded layout).

description: The onshore export cable will connect the offshore export cables to the existing grid connection point at Brayton Point
context_quote: A new underground 354-kilovolt (kV) transmission line will be constructed to connect the converter station to the existing point of interconnection (POI), the National Grid substation at Brayton Point.

description: Up to two HVDC converter stations will be constructed at the former Brayton Point Power Station site
context_quote: At the site of the former Brayton Point Power Station, up to two high voltage direct current (HVDC) converter stations will be constructed to convert the project's generated power to High Voltage Alternating Current (HVAC).

description: Six wind turbine generators (AZ-47, BA-47, BB-47, BC-47, BF-48, and BF-49) in the northeastern portion of the Lease Area will be eliminated to reduce potential impacts on foraging habitat and wildlife displacement
context_quote: Under Alternative D, six WTGs (AZ-47, BA-47, BB-47, BC-47, BF-48, and BF-49) would be eliminated in the northeastern portion of the Lease Area to reduce potential impacts on foraging habitat and potential displacement of wildlife from this habitat adjacent to Nantucket Shoals.

description: Cable installation in the Sakonnet River will be avoided to minimize impacts on fisheries habitat
context_quote: Routing the Brayton Point offshore export cable onshore to avoid the Sakonnet River could result in slight reductions in impacts on fishers that use the Sakonnet River but the difference in impact would be slight and the same overall moderate to major adverse impacts would result.

description: The number of Falmouth offshore export cables will be reduced from five to three
context_quote: Reducing the number of Falmouth offshore export cables to three would not meaningfully change the impacts on cables and pipelines because crossings would still be required at this, and other locations within the geographic analysis area.

description: The Falmouth offshore export cables will use ±525kV HVDC cables instead of HVAC cables
context_quote: To minimize seabed disturbance in the Muskeget Channel, the Falmouth offshore export cable route would use ±525kV HVDC cables connected to an HVDC converter station, instead of HVAC cables connected to offshore substations, and would only use up to 3 offshore export cables, instead of up to 5 offshore export cables.

description: The project will have a total capacity of up to 2,400 MW
context_quote: The Project would have a capacity of up to 2,400 MW and would consist of up to 147 WTGs in the Lease Area

description: The project will be developed in two phases, with up to 85 wind turbine generators in each phase
context_quote: Project 1 will develop the northeastern portion of the lease area and will include up to 85 WTGs connected by 250 miles of IACs to one (1) OSP, and up to three (3) export cables (two (2) power cables and one (1) communications cable) within the OECC to Brayton Point. Project 2 would develop the remainder of the overall project in the southern portion of the lease area and include up to 85 WTGs connected by 250 miles of IACs to one (1) OSP, and up to three (3) export cables (two (2) power cables and one (1) communications cable) within the OECC to Brayton Point.

description: The total combined number of wind turbine generators and offshore substation platforms across both project phases will not exceed 149
context_quote: As previously stated, the total combined number of WTG and OSP foundations across Project 1 and Project 2 will not exceed 149.

description: Scour and cable protection will consist of rock berms, bioactive concrete mattress placement, rock placement, and/or fronded mattresses
context_quote: Scour and cable protection will consist of rock berms, bioactive concrete mattress placement, rock placement, and/or fronded mattresses.

description: Project vessels must not travel faster than 10 knots while in the Block Island Sound Transit Lane
context_quote: To protect sensitive habitats, vessel speeds for all project vessels shall not exceed 10 knots within the Block Island Sound Transit Lane.
